debugData.name: Blender scatter (Gpu)
debugData.description: scatterTest's Geometry Nodes scatter (devTools/blender/buildScatterTest.py; p308 Phase 2) exported as GPU Instances: the node ScatterInstances, whose children hold the GPU instances (EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing) of RockA's and RockB's meshes, and the rocks' own nodes. Lossless: a scatter draws its items without their nodes, where a quantized encode puts its scale.
